# Centre for Internet & Society

> India's leading internet policy research organization advancing digital rights, open knowledge, accessibility, and inclusive technology governance.

CIS conducts trans-disciplinary research and advocacy on internet governance, intellectual property, digital inclusion, and telecom policy in India. The organization works with marginalized communities, government bodies, and international partners like Mozilla Foundation and Wikimedia Foundation to shape India's digital landscape.

## Key Topics

- Internet Governance
- Access to Knowledge (A2K)
- Open Source Software (FOSS/FLOSS)
- Disability Rights & Accessibility
- Digital Finance
- E-Governance
- Open Data & Open Access
- Telecom Policy
- Freedom of Expression
- Digital Literacy
- Intellectual Property
- Persons with Disabilities
- Rural Connectivity
- National Education Policy 2020
- Wikipedia & Wikimedia

## Core Programs & Research Areas

- [Centre for Internet & Society](https://cis-india.org): Homepage of Centre for Internet & Society, India's leading internet policy research organization
- [Internet Governance](https://cis-india.org/internet-governance): CIS internet governance work on freedom of expression, privacy, and intermediary liability
- [Access To Knowledge (A2K)](https://cis-india.org/a2k): CIS Access to Knowledge campaign on copyrights, patents, and intellectual property advocacy
- [Openness](https://cis-india.org/openness): CIS Openness program covering open data, open access, and open source initiatives in India
- [Accessibility](https://cis-india.org/accessibility): CIS accessibility program addressing disability rights and accessible content for 70M disabled Indians
- [Telecom](https://cis-india.org/telecom): CIS telecom policy research on broadband access, spectrum, and rural connectivity in India
- [researchers@work](https://cis-india.org/raw): CIS researchers@work program for trans-disciplinary research on internet and society

## Research & Reports

- [Navigating the Digitalisation of Finance: User experiences of risks and harms](https://cis-india.org/raw/navigating-the-digitalisation-of-finance): Research study on digital finance risks for marginalized users including persons with disabilities
- [State of Openness in India's E-Governance Applications](https://cis-india.org/openness/state-of-openness-in-indias-e-governance-applications): Research on open source software adoption in India's e-governance applications, Mozilla-sponsored
- [Envisioning the Role of Open Knowledge in the Implementation of the National Education Policy 2020](https://cis-india.org/a2k/envisioning-role-of-open-knowledge-in-implementation-of-national-education-policy): Analysis of open knowledge's role in implementing India's National Education Policy 2020
- [Open Movement in India (2013-23): The Idea and Its Expressions](https://cis-india.org/a2k/blogs/open-movement-in-india-idea-and-its-expressions): Report analyzing India's open movement initiatives and open knowledge expressions over decade
- [Security of Open Source Software: A Survey of Technical Stakeholders' Perceptions and Actions](https://cis-india.org/openness/security-of-open-source-software-a-survey-of-technical-stakeholders2019-perceptions-and-actions-1): Survey research on open source software security perceptions and practices of technical stakeholders

## Accessibility & Disability Rights

- [Accessibility Blog](https://cis-india.org/accessibility/blog/accessibility-blog): CIS accessibility program blog on disability rights, government guidelines, and policy commentary
- [Comments on Guidelines for Indian Government Websites](https://cis-india.org/accessibility/blog/comments-on-guidelines-for-indian-government-websites): CIS policy comments on India's Guidelines for Indian Government Websites accessibility standards
- [Comments on Mobile Accessibility Guidelines](https://cis-india.org/accessibility/blog/cis-comments-on-mobile-accessibility-guidelines): CIS policy submission on mobile accessibility guidelines and WCAG compliance for India
- [GST - A Barrier to Human Rights for Persons with Disabilities](https://cis-india.org/accessibility/blog/gst-a-barrier-to-human-rights-for-persons-with-disabilities): Analysis of GST implementation impact on disability rights and assistive technology accessibility

## Blog & Commentary

- [Openness Program Blog](https://cis-india.org/openness/blog): CIS Openness program blog covering open source, e-governance, and knowledge access topics
- [Commemorating Chandan Chiring (1990-2024)](https://cis-india.org/a2k/commemorating-chandan-chiring): Memorial post for Chandan Chiring, Assamese Wikipedia contributor and open knowledge advocate
- [Groundbreaking disability rights activist Javed Abidi dies at 53](https://cis-india.org/accessibility/blog/groundbreaking-disability-rights-activist-javed-abidi-dies-at-53): Memorial post for disability rights activist Javed Abidi, NCPEDP founder and accessibility advocate
- [Why GST Is A Step Backward For The Disabled](https://cis-india.org/accessibility/blog/why-gst-is-a-step-backward-for-the-disabled): Opinion piece on GST tax policy impact on assistive devices and persons with disabilities
